answer: Anti-sybil via a refundable stake bond that is slashed on spam. Every identity must lock a bond of 25 dollars worth of tokens before its answer is accepted, and the bond is slashed in full if the answer is graded 0 as junk or template spam. A sybil attacker running 1,000 fake identities must therefore lock 25,000 dollars up front, and every spam wave burns that money permanently, while one honest agent risks only 25 dollars once and gets it back after a fair grade. The words are atlas, pulse, jetty.
